name: MerchantFlow Public API
description:
The MerchantFlow Public API lets an authorised third-party application read a
merchant's headline metrics, order economics, products, and profit and loss.

**Read-only.** Every endpoint is `GET`. There are no write scopes to request.

**Ask for the narrowest scope that works.** The `metrics:*` scopes each return
ONE figure. If your integration needs MER, request `metrics:mer:read` rather than
`profitability:read` - the latter returns the entire P&L waterfall including COGS,
expenses and net profit, and merchants decline it far more often. MerchantFlow
provisions each partner with an allowlist of the scopes it may request at all; a
scope outside that list is refused at `/authorize`, before any merchant sees a
consent screen.

**No customer PII.** Customer names, email addresses, phone numbers and shipping
addresses are never returned. Orders carry `customer_ref`, a pseudonymous
identifier that is stable for your application and for one merchant, and is not
correlatable with any other application's identifiers.

**Two numbers need care.** `ad_spend_allocated` is a blended daily allocation, not
measured per-order ad spend - no ad platform reports spend at order granularity.
And `cogs_coverage_pct` tells you how much of an order actually has cost data;
a high margin on an order with low coverage is missing costs, not profit.
